creator: mirasplate
title: Baba Ganoush
description: Char the aubergines directly on the flame until they collapse. Oven-roasted is a different, duller dip.
steps: Char the aubergines directly over a gas flame or under a very hot grill for 20 minutes, turning, until the skins are black all over and they have collapsed.
Put them in a bowl covered with a plate for 10 minutes to steam.
Peel off the skin and drain the flesh in a sieve for 15 minutes — this is what stops it being watery.
Chop it roughly with a knife rather than blending; it should have texture.
Stir in the tahini, lemon, garlic and salt.
Spread on a plate, pour over the oil and scatter with parsley.

creator: mirasplate
title: Green Shakshuka
description: No tomato at all. Herbs, greens and feta, with the eggs cooked the same way.
steps: Soften the leek in the oil over medium heat for 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and cumin for 1 minute.
Add the spinach in handfuls, letting each wilt before the next, about 4 minutes.
Stir through the herbs and season well.
Make four wells, crack in the eggs, and scatter the feta around them.
Cover and cook 6 minutes, until the whites are set and the yolks still soft.

creator: mirasplate
title: Caponata
description: Sweet, sour and better on day two. Fry the aubergine separately or it goes grey.
steps: Fry the aubergine in most of the oil over high heat, in batches, for 6 minutes a batch until browned. Set aside.
Cook the onion and celery in the remaining oil for 10 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and simmer 12 minutes, until thickened.
Stir in the vinegar and sugar and cook 3 minutes more.
Return the aubergine with the olives and capers and cook 8 minutes.
Cool to room temperature and tear the basil through. Better still the next day.

creator: mirasplate
title: Red Lentil and Lemon Soup
description: Blend half and leave half. Fully smooth is baby food, fully chunky is stew.
steps: Cook the onion and carrot in the oil over medium heat for 10 minutes.
Add the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the lentils and stock and simmer 25 minutes, until the lentils have collapsed.
Blend half the pot and stir it back in.
Add the lemon juice off the heat and season generously — lentils take a lot of salt.

creator: mirasplate
title: Fattoush
description: The bread goes in at the last second. Soggy pita is the whole failure mode of this salad.
steps: Toast the torn pitta in a 200C oven for 8 minutes, until dry and snapping.
Whisk the pomegranate molasses, lemon juice, oil and sumac with plenty of salt.
Toss the vegetables and herbs through the dressing.
Add the bread and toss once more, then serve immediately.

creator: mirasplate
title: Rice and Herb Stuffed Peppers
description: Undercook the rice on purpose; it finishes inside the pepper drinking the juices.
steps: Heat the oven to 190C.
Cook the onion in half the oil for 8 minutes, then add the rice and turn it for 2 minutes.
Add the grated tomato and cinnamon and cook 4 minutes — the rice should still be hard.
Stir in the herbs and season well.
Fill the peppers three quarters full, since the rice will swell, and put the tops back on.
Stand them in a dish, pour the hot water and remaining oil around them, and cover with foil.
Bake 45 minutes, then uncover for 10 more, until the rice is tender and the peppers have slumped.

creator: mirasplate
title: Falafel
description: Dried chickpeas soaked overnight. Tinned chickpeas will fall apart in the oil, every time.
steps: Drain the soaked chickpeas thoroughly and pat them dry.
Blitz with the onion, garlic, herbs, cumin and 2 tsp salt until it looks like coarse couscous — not a paste.
Chill the mixture for 1 hour so it holds together.
Stir in the baking powder just before shaping and form into small flattened balls.
Heat the oil to 175C and fry in batches for 4 minutes, until deep brown and cooked through.
Drain on a rack and salt at once.

creator: mirasplate
title: Spanakopita
description: Squeeze the spinach until you think you have broken it, then squeeze again.
steps: Wilt the spinach, cool it, then squeeze it dry in a clean cloth, hard, in batches.
Chop it and mix with the feta, eggs, spring onions, dill and nutmeg. Season carefully — the feta is salty.
Brush a tin with oil and layer in six filo sheets, oiling each one.
Spread the filling and top with the remaining six, oiling as you go.
Score the top layers into portions before baking, or you will shatter it afterwards.
Bake at 180C for 45 minutes, until deep gold and crisp all over.

creator: mirasplate
title: Cauliflower Steaks with Tahini
description: Only the two middle slices hold together. Roast the rest as florets alongside.
steps: Heat the oven to 220C.
Brush the slabs with oil, season with the cumin and salt, and lay them on a hot tray.
Roast 20 minutes, turn carefully with a fish slice, and roast 15 minutes more until the edges are dark and the stem gives to a knife.
Loosen the tahini with the lemon juice, garlic and 3 tbsp cold water until it pours.
Spoon the tahini over and scatter with pomegranate and parsley.

creator: mirasplate
title: Ratatouille
description: Every vegetable cooked separately then brought together. It takes an hour and it is not the same otherwise.
steps: Fry the aubergine in 3 tbsp oil over high heat for 8 minutes, until browned. Set aside.
Do the same with the courgette, 5 minutes, and the peppers, 8 minutes, each on its own.
Cook the onion gently in the last of the oil for 12 minutes, then add the garlic and thyme.
Add the tomatoes and cook 15 minutes, until they break down into a sauce.
Return everything to the pan and simmer together for 15 minutes.
Season, tear in the basil, and let it sit 20 minutes before eating.

creator: mirasplate
title: Proper Hummus
description: Peel the chickpeas. It is tedious and it is the entire difference between good and silky.
steps: Cook the drained chickpeas with the bicarbonate in fresh water for 50 minutes, until they squash between two fingers with no resistance.
Skim the skins off as they float, and pinch off any that remain.
Blend the garlic with the lemon juice first and leave it 10 minutes, then strain it — this takes the raw edge off.
Blend the hot chickpeas with the tahini, lemon liquid, cumin and salt for a full 3 minutes.
Add iced water a tablespoon at a time until it turns pale and loose; it firms as it cools.
Spread on a plate and pour the oil over.

creator: mirasplate
title: Tabbouleh
description: Parsley with some bulgur in it, not the other way round. Chop by hand; a processor bruises it.
steps: Soak the bulgur in 3 tbsp of the lemon juice for 20 minutes; it needs no water and no cooking.
Chop the parsley by hand as finely as you can, stalks removed.
Drain the diced tomato in a sieve for 10 minutes so it does not flood the bowl.
Combine everything with the oil and remaining lemon and season well.
Eat within an hour, before the parsley darkens.

creator: mirasplate
title: Lemon and Feta Orzo
description: Cooked like risotto so the starch makes the sauce. No cream anywhere near it.
steps: Warm the oil and cook the garlic gently for 1 minute without browning.
Add the orzo and turn it for 1 minute.
Add the stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for about 12 minutes, until the orzo is tender and creamy.
Stir in the peas for the last 3 minutes.
Off the heat, add the lemon zest and juice, half the feta and the dill.
Top with the rest of the feta.

creator: mirasplate
title: Mushroom Ragù
description: Dried porcini and their soaking liquid do the work meat usually does.
steps: Soak the porcini in 1 cup of boiling water for 20 minutes, then chop them and keep the liquid.
Cook the onion, carrot and celery in the oil over medium-low heat for 15 minutes, until soft and sweet.
Add all the mushrooms and cook 10 minutes over higher heat, until they have released their water and it has gone.
Stir in the tomato purée for 2 minutes.
Add the wine and reduce by half, then the porcini liquid, leaving the grit behind.
Simmer 20 minutes, until thick. Toss with the pasta and a splash of its cooking water.

creator: mirasplate
title: Gigantes Plaki
description: Butter beans baked in tomato until the top ones go crisp. Eat warm, not hot.
steps: Heat the oven to 180C.
Cook the onion in the oil over medium heat for 10 minutes, then add the garlic for 1 minute.
Stir in the tomato purée, tomatoes, oregano and sugar and simmer 10 minutes.
Fold in the beans and season well, then tip into a baking dish.
Bake uncovered for 50 minutes, until the sauce has reduced and the beans on top have browned.
Stir the dill through and leave 15 minutes before eating.

creator: mirasplate
title: Courgette Fritters
description: Salt and squeeze the courgette. Skip that and the batter never sets.
steps: Toss the grated courgette with the salt and leave 20 minutes in a colander.
Squeeze it dry in a cloth, as hard as you can — you should get out a surprising amount of water.
Mix with the feta, eggs, flour, dill and spring onion.
Fry heaped spoonfuls in the oil over medium heat for 3 minutes a side, flattening slightly, until deep gold and set through.
Drain on a rack and eat warm.

creator: mirasplate
title: Tuscan White Bean Soup
description: Blend a cupful and return it. That is how it thickens without any flour.
steps: Cook the onion, celery and carrot in the oil over medium-low heat for 15 minutes, until soft without colour.
Add the garlic and rosemary for 2 minutes.
Add the beans and stock and simmer 15 minutes.
Blend a cupful smooth and stir it back in to thicken the soup.
Add the cavolo nero and cook 8 minutes more, until tender.
Season hard and pour olive oil over each bowl.

creator: mirasplate
title: Aubergine Parmigiana
description: Grill the aubergine instead of frying it. Less oil and it holds its shape in the layers.
steps: Brush the aubergine slices with oil and grill for 4 minutes a side, until soft and marked.
Cook the garlic gently in the rest of the oil for 1 minute, add the tomatoes, and simmer 25 minutes until thick.
Tear the basil into the sauce and season.
Layer aubergine, sauce, mozzarella and Parmesan in a dish, three times, finishing with Parmesan.
Bake at 190C for 35 minutes, until browned and bubbling at the edges.
Rest 20 minutes before cutting or it will not hold together.

creator: mirasplate
title: Labneh with Za'atar
description: Yoghurt strained overnight into cheese. One ingredient and a bit of patience.
steps: Stir the salt through the yoghurt.
Line a sieve with muslin or a clean cloth, tip the yoghurt in, and gather the corners.
Sit it over a bowl in the fridge for 24 hours, until it is firm enough to hold a shape.
Spread on a plate, make a well with the back of a spoon, and pour the oil in.
Scatter with za'atar and serve with warm flatbread.

creator: mirasplate
title: Village Greek Salad
description: No lettuce. The tomatoes have to be good because there is nowhere for them to hide.
steps: Salt the tomato wedges and leave them 10 minutes; the juice they give up becomes part of the dressing.
Add the cucumber, onion, pepper and olives and turn everything together.
Pour over the oil and vinegar and toss once, gently.
Lay the feta on top in one piece and crush the oregano over it between your fingers.
Serve with bread, and do not let anyone leave the juice in the bowl.
